label: Lower third / overlay

kinds.lower: A name and role card that slides in at the bottom left, holds, and slides out.
kinds.caption: A short line of text on a dark band at the bottom centre.
kinds.bug: The brand logo, with an optional short text, in the top right corner.

fields.name: The person's name.
fields.caption.text: One short line, e.g. the place or the date.
fields.bug.text: Optional short text next to the logo, e.g. "LIVE".
fields.theme: light: a white card; dark: a dark card for bright footage.
fields.vo: Usually empty: overlays sit on footage that has its own sound.

description: Overlays to lay over footage in any editor: a name and role lower third, a caption band and a logo bug, each sliding in and out on a transparent background. Renders a .mov with an alpha channel (ProRes 4444) next to the usual MP4.
